prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Protect Your Pet Companion in the Cloud", "Sign in to ensure your pet status, custom appearance, and items are safely backed up across sessions."]
1: ["Preview and set desktop pet placement spot while rendering"]
2: ["Ready to launch your desktop companion!", "Review essential desktop controls: Right-click for menu, drag to move across desktop, or press ESC to dismiss."]
3: ["Customize Pet Desktop Behavior", "Select how active and vocal your pet should be while working on your desktop."]
4: ["Select Your Desktop Pet Journey", "Swipe to compare quick start adoption vs fully customized photo pet paths."]
5: ["Signing in automatically backs up your pet state so your companion never resets."]
6: ["Upload Pet Photo for 3D Creation", "Ensure high contrast and centered lighting for best desktop pet rendering results."]
7: ["Configuring Desktop Screen Overlay", "Setting up graphics compatibility so your pet roams seamlessly above all open desktop windows."]
8: ["Click your pet anytime on the desktop screen to bring it to the front or open shortcut actions."]
9: ["Choose Your Quick Path", "Pick a instant companion (1 min setup) or upload photos for a custom 3D pet (3 min setup)."]
